candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its POST /v1/orders call to the order service fails with transport errors at ~2s, indicating downstream order-service latency/timeout rather than a gateway fault.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-service logs/metrics not observed; cannot confirm whether order itself is slow or blocked on inventory/payment/postgresql.

report.explanation: Gateway logs show repeated 502 on /v1/checkout paired with transport errors on client calls to order at ~2s, while /readyz stays 200. This localizes the failure to the gateway->order dependency; downstream-latency is the best-supported bounded candidate, but order-side evidence is needed to confirm the root.
missing_evidence: Order-service logs and metrics for POST /v1/orders latency and error type
Dependency metrics for order->inventory, order->payment, order->postgresql to localize the ~2s stall
